_note: Demo recipes written for the Mise project. Not taken from any external dataset.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: A fast weeknight fried rice that turns leftover rice into dinner.
recipes.instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan or wok over high heat. Cook the chicken until browned and cooked through, then move it to a plate.
Add the beaten eggs to the pan and scramble until just set. Move them to the plate with the chicken.
Add the remaining oil and the garlic. Stir for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and press it into the pan. Let it sit for a minute to crisp, then stir. Repeat a few times.
Add the peas, soy sauce, chicken, and eggs. Toss until everything is hot.
Stir in the green onion and sesame oil. Season with salt.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: The simplest fried rice: rice, eggs, and green onion.
recipes.instructions:
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until about half set.
Add the rice right away and toss so the egg coats the grains.
Add the soy sauce and keep tossing until the rice is hot and slightly crisp.
Stir in the green onion and season with salt.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken thighs in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, and ginger in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken skin side down for 6 to 7 minutes, until golden.
Flip and cook another 5 minutes.
Pour off excess fat, add the sauce, and simmer, turning the chicken, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Slice and serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Oyakodon
recipes.description: Chicken and egg simmered in a sweet and savory broth, served over rice.
recipes.instructions:
Bring the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to a simmer in a small pan.
Add the onion and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Pour the eggs over the top in a slow circle. Cover and cook for 1 minute, until the eggs are just barely set.
Slide over bowls of rice and top with green onion.

recipes.title: Miso Ramen-Style Noodles
recipes.description: A quick miso broth with noodles, soft eggs, and whatever toppings you have.
recipes.instructions:
Boil the eggs for 6 and a half minutes, then cool them in ice water and peel.
Warm the sesame oil in a pot and cook the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and bring to a simmer. Whisk in the miso and soy sauce. Do not let it boil hard after adding miso.
Cook the noodles separately according to the package, then drain.
Divide the noodles between bowls, ladle the broth over, and top with halved eggs, corn, and green onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken in a spiced tomato cream sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Mix the chicken with the yogurt, half the garam masala, and a pinch of salt. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
Broil or pan-sear the chicken until charred in spots. It does not need to be cooked through yet.
Melt the butter in a large pan. Cook the onion until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, chili powder, and the rest of the garam masala. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream and the chicken. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Mild, rich, and buttery. A good first Indian curry to learn.
recipes.instructions:
Toss the chicken with the yogurt, turmeric, and a pinch of salt.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large pan and brown the chicken in batches. Set aside.
Melt the remaining butter. Cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, garam masala, and chili powder. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth if you like.
Return the chicken, stir in the cream, and simmer for 5 minutes. Season with salt and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy, spiced tomato and onion sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Heat the oil in a pot and cook the onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and garam masala. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and a splash of water. Simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
Season with salt and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Pasta with garlic, olive oil, and chili flakes. Ready in 20 minutes from pantry staples.
recipes.instructions:
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until just shy of al dente. Save 1 cup of the pasta water.
While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil and garlic in a large pan over medium-low heat until the garlic is pale gold.
Add the red pepper flakes and stir for 10 seconds.
Add the pasta and half a cup of pasta water. Toss hard until the sauce turns glossy, adding more water if needed.
Finish with parsley and parmesan.

recipes.title: Pasta Pomodoro
recipes.description: A simple tomato sauce pasta with garlic and basil.
recipes.instructions:
Warm the olive oil and garlic in a saucepan until the garlic is fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Save a little pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Serve with basil and parmesan.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Penne and chicken in a garlic parmesan cream sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Cook the penne in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Brown it in the butter until cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Stir in the parmesan until melted.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Toss in the pasta and chicken. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced chicken thighs in warm corn tortillas with lime and cilantro.
recipes.instructions:
Rub the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, garlic, the juice of 1 lime, and salt.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes, then chop.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, onion, cilantro, avocado, and salsa. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Classic crowd-pleasing beef tacos with cheddar and lettuce.
recipes.instructions:
Brown the beef with the onion in a skillet, breaking it up as it cooks. Drain excess fat.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, a pinch of salt, and a splash of water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef and top with cheddar, lettuce, tomato, and sour cream.

recipes.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy, cheesy, and ready in 15 minutes.
recipes.instructions:
Mash the beans lightly with the cumin.
Spread beans over half of each tortilla, top with cheese, and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender sliced beef and broccoli in a savory brown sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and 3 tbsp water for the sauce.
Steam or blanch the broccoli for 2 minutes until bright green.
Sear the beef in hot oil in batches, then set aside.
Cook the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, add the sauce, beef, and broccoli, and toss until glossy. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: A flexible stir-fry that works with most vegetables in your fridge.
recipes.instructions:
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp hot oil until cooked through. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the carrot and broccoli for 3 minutes, then the bell pepper for 2 more.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the remaining soy sauce and the oyster sauce, and toss. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: Tangy, spicy fried rice topped with a fried egg.
recipes.instructions:
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and cook the kimchi for 3 minutes.
Stir in the gochujang, then add the rice, kimchi juice, and soy sauce. Toss until hot.
Stir in the sesame oil and green onion.
Fry the eggs sunny side up and place one on each bowl.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken
recipes.description: Pad krapow gai: ground chicken stir-fried with holy basil and chilies.
recipes.instructions:
Mix the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and chilies for 15 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add the sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Turn off the heat and stir in the basil until wilted.
Serve over rice with a fried egg on top.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet. Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and paprika. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook on low for 5 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top with feta.

recipes.title: Classic Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy weekend pancakes from basic pantry ingredients.
recipes.instructions:
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour a quarter cup of batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles form on top, then cook until golden on the other side.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon with a quick garlic lemon butter sauce.
recipes.instructions:
Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin side down for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes more. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat, add the butter and garlic, and cook for 1 minute.
Squeeze in the juice of half the lemon, spoon the sauce over the salmon, and top with parsley.
